Emma S.: Hey team — Prospect (MediCore) pushed back on the MSA DPA redlines and wants e-sign routing for two execs. Can legal confirm if we can accept their SLA tweak (remove 99.9% uptime carve) and what signature path we should use?
Jason (Legal): Can you paste the exact clause they changed? quick check: are they asking to change SLOs or remove remedies?
Emma S.: They removed the 99.9% uptime SLA and replaced with 'commercially reasonable efforts' + removed uptime credits. Snippet below I got from their counsel:
```
SLA: Provider shall use commercially reasonable efforts to make the Platform available. Customer remedies for unavailability are limited to termination for material breach.
```
Emma S.: They also request countersignature from their CFO + VP Procurement (two signers).
Carlos - SalesOps: For e-sign we usually do single sign + countersign via DocuSign; two signers is fine but needs correct routing. Do we need Exec signature on our side?
Priya F.: Finance: We'll need a PO and invoice terms confirmed before countersign. MediCore asked for Net60 — can we accept? That impacts credit review.
Peter: Sales: I already ran credit — Net60 is ok pending credit hold approval. Can we keep Net30 on the order form and do a one-off Net60 via billing approval?
Jason (Legal): On SLA: removing uptime credits in favor of termination only is a downgrade for us. We can accept 'commercially reasonable efforts' only if we re-add a minimal uptime objective for critical customers. I'll draft a middle-ground clause and need 24h to review with counsel.
Emma S.: Thanks. Can you also confirm signature template? Example routing we need: MediCore CFO -> MediCore VP Procurement -> Redwood Sales Exec -> Redwood CFO. That way their legal signs first.
Carlos - SalesOps: For DocuSign routing use recipient order: signer1 (email1), signer2 (email2), then our account. I'll prepare an envelope template. Any special attachments?
Emma S.: Attach final order form + one-page SOW (see below). Also need KMS attestation removed from order form (they asked to avoid HSM language).
Priya F.: On Net60: Finance can approve Net60 for this account but requires a billing hold code and Trade Reference form. I can send the form to MediCore.
Jason (Legal): I'll post the redlined clause here by EOD. If SalesOps can queue DocuSign after legal ack, we should be good.
esign-bot: DocuSign envelope created (env_0a9c) by Carlos - SalesOps. Link: https://docusign.example/env/env_0a9c :paperclip: 
Carlos - SalesOps: Dropped the envelope and added Emma + Peter as recipients on our side. Set routing so MediCore signs first.
Emma S.: Awesome. Quick checklist: (1) Jason posts redline, (2) Priya sends trade refs + PO term confirmation, (3) Carlos sends DocuSign to counterparty once legal ack. Anyone object to that flow? :thumbsup:
Jason (Legal): 👍 no objections, will try to get redlines in before COB.
Priya F.: Sending trade reference form to MediCore now.
Emma S.: Thanks all — ping me if blocked.
